description.value: Golphis Steak & Lobster is a Port Moody institution established in 1973, serving steaks, lobster, pizza, Greek dishes, pasta, and seafood in a full-service dining room. The restaurant has cultivated a devoted local following over five decades and is notably open after-hours throughout the week. Dine-in, pickup, and local delivery are all available, with Visa, Mastercard, and American Express accepted.
